selection: Usuário escolheu a primeira proposta: olhos expressivos e sorriso amigável.
prompt: Create ONE minimalist brand symbol proposal for PingoFin by synthesizing the supplied approved Pingo mascot. Image 1 is the official character reference board; image 2 shows the individual character clearly. Use these references for identity and silhouette only, not their illustration rendering or extra details. Deliver a single isolated centered symbol on a genuinely transparent square canvas, with balanced clear margins, occupying approximately 80% of the canvas. No text or typography anywhere. Preserve the recognizable rounded purple droplet body and its distinctive softly curled, hooked yellow top: the yellow area follows the curved tip and sweeps inward like the supplied mascot, not a separate flame or detached accessory. Reduce the face to two simple friendly eyes and one small rounded smile. Make those facial shapes generous, optically balanced, with clear negative-space cutouts that remain readable at favicon scale and can work in a future single-color silhouette. Remove arms, hands, legs, eyebrows, blush, tongue, eye glints, props and all decorative marks. Strong compact outer silhouette, clean smooth Bézier-like curves, minimal anchor-point aesthetic, no thin delicate lines, no tiny enclosed gaps. Exact flat palette only: body purple #5B2A86, deep purple #371653 for a restrained robust outer contour where necessary, yellow #FBBF24 for the curved top. All fills solid and uniform. The recognizable character-to-brand-symbol relationship is the goal; Wiser is only a conceptual analogy for this relationship, do not reproduce or reference its logo geometry. The result should feel like a professional, approachable financial software brand symbol synthesized from Pingo, never a generic water-drop logo or a detailed cartoon. Design one fixed geometry suitable for future color, monochrome and light/dark adaptations; produce only this one color version now. Flat vector-friendly graphic appearance appropriate for subsequent manual vector construction. Absolutely no gradients, shading, shadows, 3D, lighting effects, gloss, texture, background shapes, rounded-square icon container, mockups, application screenshots, variant grids, lettering, or watermarks. Transparent background including facial negative spaces.
resultNote: O resultado v1 foi escolhido apesar de manter olhos detalhados e pequenas variações de preenchimento. A seleção do usuário prevalece; exportações não alteram a imagem para impor o prompt original.

export.method: Redimensionamento bicúbico com System.Drawing; ICO com quatro frames PNG. Sem nova geração, recoloração ou alteração geométrica.
